title: ligularia jacquemontiana
intro: Ligularia jacquemontiana, commonly known as Indian Mastich, is a plant species in the sunflower family, Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities that may aid in reducing inflammation, preventing infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Ligularia jacquemontiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, among others, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, including gastrointestinal issues, fever, and skin disorders, and its bioactive constituents are being studied for potential use in the development of new medicinal products.
